I just placed an order with two watches, and I need to make some changes.

Sure—I can help modify your order, but first I need to authenticate you.

Please provide **one** of the following:
1) **Email address** used at checkout, **or**
2) **First name + Last name + ZIP code**

Also, what is your **order ID** (e.g., `#W0000000`)?
My name is Noah Ito and my zip code is 98187. I don’t have my order ID handy right now.
noah_ito_3850

Thanks, Noah—I found your account: **noah_ito_3850**.

To modify your order, I still need to locate the specific **order ID** (I can’t take action without the exact order).

Please tell me one of the following:
- the **email** you used at checkout, or
- the **approximate order date/time** (and/or whether it was delivered yet), or
- the **shipping city/state** from the order confirmation.

Once I have that, I can look up your orders and help change the two watches.
I placed the order just today, and it hasn’t shipped yet. The shipping city is Seattle, Washington.

Yes, #W4219264. I want to do A and C.

First, please change the shipping address to my New York address—the same one as in my other order.

Second, for the silicone strap watch, I want to switch it to a metal strap instead. If there are color options for the metal, I’d like white. The other watch can stay as is.

Got it, Noah. I can help with **(A) address change** and **(C) watch option change** for your pending order **#W4219264**.

In **#W4219264**, you have two watches:
1) **Silicone strap, dial blue** (item id **8886009523**) → you want **metal strap**, and you’d like the metal/watch color to be **white** (I’m assuming **dial color = white**).

- **credit card (mastercard •••• 1065)**

Please reply with:
1) Confirmation for the watch change: **“yes”**  
2) Payment method for any price difference: **credit card** (or a gift card if you have one)

Once you confirm, I’ll look up the exact metal/white variant available and apply the change.

Yes, please update the address to the New York one.

And yes, change the silicone strap watch to a metal strap, white if possible. Use my credit card for any price difference.
